sloka: एवमुक्तो ऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम् ।एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः ।विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ६.१२६.२२ ।।
transliteration: evamukto 'tha vaidehyā rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca tām ।evamastviti kiṣkindhāṁ prāpya saṁsthāpya rāghavaḥ ।vimānaṁ prekṣya sugrīvaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 6.126.22 ।।

translations.english: "Here is a cavern where all these troops were stationed before crossing the ocean. At this place Lord MahaDeva bestowed his grace on me (before construction of the bridge)."
